assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished raster background for a dance school website category card, square 1536x1536. Primary request: an extremely clean minimal abstract graphic, inspired ONLY by the pale ice blue background, gently curving blue waves and fine lines of the supplied team portrait; remove all human content and do not reproduce any portrait. Visual language: refined flat graphic composition with a little translucent layering, restrained elegant editorial brand art. Palette exactly a very pale sky-blue field (#e4f3fc), a single translucent pastel sky-blue form (#b9def6), and one or two very fine muted blue accent curves (#9bcbe8). Keep the entire central 60% completely calm and light, clear empty space for DARK text that the website adds later. Confine the few graphic forms to outer edges/corners; create generous negative space. Only 1 broad form and 2 fine strokes maximum. Full bleed, no border. Absolutely NO people, bodies, faces, silhouettes, hands, shoes, objects, letters, symbols, logos, typography, watermarks, musical notation, glitter, clutter, busy mesh, gradients with harsh contrast, 3D objects or mockup. Output one finished background image only. Category mood: Classical and Modern Dance. One graceful elongated arc like a broad flowing ribbon bending upward along the left edge and bottom corner; two fine long parallel curved lines gently sweeping across the top-left toward the upper-right, leaving the middle open. Soft disciplined elegance, not intricate.
